instructions: Weight-space programming workbench. Inspect exact parameters before editing. Submit a pinned baseline, candidate, and independent regression cases. Submission returns immediately: poll get_run until terminal. Failed/unscored runs are not evidence of improvement. Tiny results are engineering fixtures. Activation interventions are diagnostic.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel an owned queued/running job; completed records remain immutable.

tools.name: cancel_study_attempt
tools.description: Request candidate cancellation; consumed study reservations are not refunded.

tools.name: cancel_study_final
tools.description: Stop final evaluation; the nominee remains frozen and the result is inconclusive.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Discover supported backends, operations and limits without loading a model.

tools.name: compare_runs
tools.description: Compare compatible scored runs, exposing improvements and regressions separately.

tools.name: finalize_study
tools.description: Freeze one completed nominee and queue its one-shot held-out evaluation.

tools.name: get_capture
tools.description: Page stored activation values with their capture position and invocation metadata.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Page teacher-forced token probabilities; these are not generated task outcomes.

tools.name: get_inspection
tools.description: Page a completed run's tensor catalog and captured pre-edit weights.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read status/results; large records return an explicit summary and artifact handle.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Read one sample, bounded output text, captures and exact weight-change evidence.

tools.name: get_samples
tools.description: Enumerate bounded sample summaries, including when the complete run is truncated.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Read study design summary, cumulative reservations and aggregate final evidence.

tools.name: get_study_assessment
tools.description: Page complete assessment JSON; omit attempt_id for public aggregate final evidence.

tools.name: get_study_attempt
tools.description: Read a candidate attempt's status and aggregate development assessment.

tools.name: get_study_case_messages
tools.description: Read bounded chat messages for development cases only; never sealed holdout text.

tools.name: get_study_case_spec
tools.description: Page complete development case JSON including chat and scoring constraints.

tools.name: get_study_cases
tools.description: Page public development cases and expectations; never returns held-out cases.

tools.name: get_study_comparator
tools.description: Page registered comparator configuration and its measured model identity.

tools.name: get_study_samples
tools.description: Read bounded development outputs for baseline/no_op/control:NAME/candidate arms.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the latest local run summaries.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.description: Find operator-provisioned studies without accessing sealed cases.

tools.name: list_study_attempts
tools.description: Page all candidate attempts, preserving unsuccessful and cancelled attempts.

tools.name: submit_experiment
tools.description: Queue a bounded experiment; identical request IDs are idempotent.

tools.name: submit_inspection
tools.description: Queue a model catalog and bounded parameter reads without forward passes.

tools.name: submit_study_candidate
tools.description: Admit a frozen candidate and queue baseline/control/candidate development runs.
